data.text: I commit to choosing 15 tons this month and donating the $15,000 proceeds directly to the clinic. Protecting our neighbors matters, and the lake can recover if we keep this a genuine one-month exception. I also commit to 6 tons next month under the proposed recovery plan, then 10 tons each once the lake is back at 100. Let’s share donation receipts alongside our catch reports so everyone can see the treatment was funded. John, can you confirm your part?
